page_title: IPS 0-4 NEW | Ipswich v Newcastle 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Newcastle players look gutted.
90+4' Wait! Referee Stuart Attwell has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+3' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends a chip pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric is quickest to intercept the ball.

89' Newcastle slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
86' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
83' Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
80' Today's match ends for Bruno Guimaraes who will be replaced by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sammie Szmodics departs the field of play to be replaced by Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich).
78' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) replacing Wes Burns.
76' Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
75' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexander Isak trots off the pitch and is replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
72' Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
71' Ipswich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Ipswich are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. It will be a corner kick for Ipswich.
69' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.
67' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book Samy Morsy (Ipswich) for his harsh tackle.
65' Substitution. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Joe Willock walks off.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Jacob Murphy.
64' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Valentino Livramento and he is replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).

64' Wes Burns (Ipswich) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

63' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Arijanet Muric thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
62' Here is a change. Jens Cajuste is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich).
62' Conor Chaplin goes off the pitch and Jack Taylor (Ipswich) comes on.
62' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
58' Ipswich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
57' Shots on target – 1:6.
54' 0 - 4 Goal - 0:4! Jacob Murphy tees up Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Arijanet Muric.
52' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post! The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
50' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.

48' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Newcastle are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' It's time for a substitution. Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) comes on in place of Omari Hutchinson.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+6' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+2' 0 - 3 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:3.
45+1' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

44' Newcastle slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
42' A pass into the box finds Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Arijanet Muric denies him.

41' The cross into the penalty area from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
40' Ipswich showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
38' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) and Anthony Gordon try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
36' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

32' 0 - 2 Anthony Gordon passes the ball into the penalty area. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:2!
31' Half-chance! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) plays a pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric reacts well to snuff out the attack.

30' Ipswich show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Ipswich will take a throw-in.
27' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Wes Burns (Ipswich) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
24' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Arijanet Muric is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
24' Ipswich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

21' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
19' Harry Clarke (Ipswich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
16' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.

15' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
14' Martin Dubravka is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Harry Clarke (Ipswich). Easy save!
12' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
7' Wonderful movement by Newcastle. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

3' 0 - 1 Stuart Attwell sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands! Goal 0:1! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
3' The Newcastle players joy may have been justified, because referee Stuart Attwell is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
1' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
1' The first half has started.
Stuart Attwell got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
